12.t: Working with data: the ozone layer
q: Read the ozone hole area in 1990.
The hole has stopped growing and is slowly getting smaller.
CFCs were banned in 1987, but they kept rising until 2000. Suggest why.
Old fridges and sprays kept leaking CFCs, and the ban was phased in over years.
Explain why the ozone hole is shrinking only slowly.
CFCs stay in the air for decades, and each CFC molecule releases chlorine that destroys many ozone molecules, so recovery takes a long time.
